messages:
Jen Park: Quick reminder — this is the last call for v1.12.0 changelog entries. Cutoff is today at 17:00 PT. Please add a single entry per PR into keep-a-changelog.md (under /docs/releases/) and follow the one-line + optional detail pattern.

Praveen Nair: If my PR is a small patch (typo + tests), do I still add a changelog entry?

Jen Park: yes — short doc-only or test-only entries can be a one-liner under the "docs/tests" component. We want everything discoverable.

Liz Chen: Quick question on format — should we include component tags and owner? e.g. `[runtime] (infra): fix batching`

devex-bot: Here’s the recommended minimal shape (copy/paste):
```
- [component] Brief one-line summary (PR #1234)
  - optional: single sentence with context and migration notes
  - owner: @display-name
```
Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/CHANGELOG_TEMPLATE.md

Sam Ortiz: If a PR touches both docs and runtime, use the primary visible surface (runtime) and add `(docs)` in the optional sentence. Don’t split into two entries.

Alex Rivera: Who's taking changelog review? I can do a pass at 15:30 PT if someone pings me when done.

Liz Chen: happy to do the first sweep. Alex — can you do final read after I tidy the wording?

Jen Park: assigning review -> Liz (first pass) + Alex (final). I’ll mark the release branch so any late merges must be approved by Liz.

release-bot: scheduled: v1.12.0 cutover job set for 17:30 PT — will fail if changelog not merged by 17:05 PT.

Praveen Nair: noted — I’ll add my entry now. One small ask: can we standardize tags? I propose: `[runtime]`, `[api]`, `[console]`, `[docs]`, `[infra]`.

Jen Park: agreed on those tags. Add them to the template header. Small checklist for everyone: 
- add one-line entry to /docs/releases/keep-a-changelog.md
- include component tag and PR number
- add owner (optional)
- if breaking change, add `BREAKING:` prefix and a single migration sentence

Sam Ortiz: tiny nit — please avoid linking full PR body in the entry, just `PR #1234` is fine.

Liz Chen: doing pass now, will ping @Alex Rivera for final read.

Alex Rivera: :thumbsup: will watch for Liz ping and do final sweep at 15:30 PT.

Jen Park: thanks all — last call is live. If you can't make the window, leave a draft and mark it `WIP changelog` so reviewers can finish it.

Praveen Nair: done and pushed. Entry follows template.

release-bot: changelog check: 6 entries present, 2 flagged for formatting nits. See /releases/checks/1951234567 for details.

Jen Park: I’ll fix the flagged ones with Liz. If everything passes by 17:05 PT we cut.

Sam Ortiz: copy — will avoid late non-critical updates after 16:45 PT.

Liz Chen: flagged items fixed and pushed. Marked as ready for Alex.

Alex Rivera: reviewed and approved. :white_check_mark: ready for merge.

release-bot: merge window opened for v1.12.0 branch.

Jen Park: excellent — thanks team. Post-release retrospective note: we should add a lint job to CI for changelog shape to avoid manual nits.

devex-bot: noted — created ticket INF-742 to add changelog linter in CI.
